title: Jehoiakim year 4 = Nebuchadnezzar year 1 (Jer 25:1)
external_entity: Nebuchadnezzar II's regnal years (Babylonian, from ABC 5)
proposed_synchronization: Jeremiah 25:1 equates Jehoiakim's fourth year with Nebuchadnezzar's first; the Babylonian accession on 7 Sep 605 fixes Nebuchadnezzar's years.
dating_method: Nebuchadnezzar's accession year (Sep 605 – Nisan 604) and year 1 (Nisan 604 – Nisan 603)
assumptions: Whether Jeremiah counts Nebuchadnezzar's accession year as "first" is modelled as an alternative.
